newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX noon Nikkei weakens on technical sell-off.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX noon Nikkei weakens on technical sell-off.

text.p: Weak technicals pressured the SIMEX 225-share Nikkei index futures lower at midday on Friday, overshadowing the rally on Wall Street overnight, dealers said.
"Since Wednesday, SIMEX has been testing various sell stop triggers. Today, we see that selling continuing by most funds," a dealer with a local institution said.
Dealers said the Nikkei futures were threatened by funds switching to the more lucrative Japanese bond markets, which had been on an uptrend as fears of near-term Japanese rate hikes subsided.
At 0245 GMT, the benchmark September Nikkei futures was down 215 points at 19,965 after opening at 20,220. Volume was about 7,030 lots.
September futures was seen testing 19,800 support next.
July SIMEX Taiwan stock index futures was up 3.8 points at 388.5 on turnover of 300 lots.
